sources.excerpt: BluesFuzz Jr by Amptweaker | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Amptweaker BluesFuzz Jr LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ BOOSTER Description The BluesFuzz Jr fuzz pedal is based on the BluesFuzz Limited, a sought-after 49 piece model that used a low gain germanium transistor with boost, mid EQ, and Tight attack switch. It shares most of the tone-tweaking features available on its larger counterpart, while eliminating some features most players don't need in order to shrink down the size and weight. Derived from the Pro series, the Tight control and Fat switches were re-configured into a 3-position Fat/Normal/Tight switch to dial in the attack of the notes from thick and heavy to aggressive and chunky. Since this model uses a low gain germanium transistor, an input boost is included to give thicker fuzz tones. And to help dial in the all-important mid frequencies, there's a Mid control that matches the tone of the original BluesFuzz when set in the middle. The ingenious automatically adjusting bias on the Fuzz controls keeps the sweet spot at hand, and is especially nice for cleaner tones. 0 Media Videos Amptweaker BluesFuzz JR demo by Mike Hermans Amptweaker BluesFuzz JR official demo Manuals Manual (DE) Manual (EN) Reviews Amptweaker Bass Blues Fuzz - Review by Bonedo, [03-2019] DE Review by bonedo (DE) Review by Bass Gear Mag (EN) Technical data Width 000.00 mm Depth 000.00 mm Height 000.00 mm Weight 000.00 mm Circuit type analog Voltage 9V DC, center negative Current 11mA More pedals from Amptweaker EQUALIZER EQUALIZER Amptweaker DepthFinder FUZZ FUZZ Amptweaker Bass BluesFuzz Jr OVERDRIVE PREAMP OVERDRIVE PREAMP Amptweaker Bass TightDrive OVERDRIVE NOISE GATE OVERDRIVE NOISE GATE Amptweaker Bass TightDrive Jr All Amptweaker Pedals Products Pedalboards All-In-One Patchbays QuickMount PedalSafe Power Supplies and Power Cables and Connections Accessories Gear Build your own board Board Configurator PedalPedia Pedalboard Gallery QuickMount Finder Services Find a dealer Find a distributor Frequently Asked Questions Contact Current catalog News Community RockBoard Artists Achievements Your Activity Overview ©2026 Warwick GmbH Co.
